name: Softening The Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that the human heart is naturally deceitful and wicked, as seen in Genesis 6:5 and Jeremiah 17:9, where man's thoughts are continually evil and the heart is described as desperately wicked. God, in His sovereign will, can harden hearts as with Pharaoh (Exodus 7:3), but He also promises to transform hearts by removing the stony, unresponsive condition and granting a new, tender heart and spirit (Ezekiel 11:19). True spiritual renewal involves God creating a clean heart and a right spirit within us (Psalms 51:10), enabling us to know Him fully and return to Him wholeheartedly (Jeremiah 24:7).
